name: Chris Ozols
description: Personal GitHub site of Chris Ozols, with mathematical proofs and refutations and their verification.

proofs.heading: Mathematical proofs
proofs.title: Mathematical Proofs — Chris Ozols
proofs.description: Proofs of published mathematical conjectures with reproducible Lean verification, exact statements, trust models, and prior-art notes. No novelty or priority is claimed.
proofs.introHtml: These are mathematical proofs I have made available with reproducible verification. For each problem, I searched for an existing proof and did not find one in the sources I examined.

refutations.heading: Mathematical refutations
refutations.title: Mathematical Refutations — Chris Ozols
refutations.description: Counterexamples to published mathematical claims, with exact witnesses, reproducible verification, and prior-art notes, including disclosure of earlier refutations.
refutations.introHtml: These are counterexamples and refutations from my mathematical investigations. Each entry gives the statement being challenged, the counterexample, and the available verification. Prior-art searches and known earlier results, including earlier refutations, are documented with each entry.
refutations.empty: No entries are published yet. Entries are added once the counterexample can be checked independently and its prior-art notes, including any earlier refutations, are complete.
